item.title: Service Ad Without Source Assets

turns.text: Make an 8-second 16:9 ad for ClearDay, a made-up app that turns a messy to-do list into a simple daily plan. I don't have screenshots or a logo—create a simple demo screen yourself. Show the messy list becoming an organized day, then end on ClearDay. Calm blue-and-white look, no sound. Any other wording is up to you.

item.tests: Creates a coherent app ad without supplied assets, visibly demonstrating the service instead of requiring screenshots.

answer_sheet.Service and purpose: ClearDay, a fictional app that organizes a messy to-do list into a daily plan.
answer_sheet.Screenshots and logo: None supplied; create a simple demo screen and choose the branding treatment yourself.
answer_sheet.Wording and language: End on ClearDay; other wording is your call, in English.

must_haves: The final video is 8 seconds long and landscape 16:9.
A created app demo visibly changes from a messy task list into an organized daily plan.
The visual design is predominantly blue and white with a calm presentation.

goal.why: The user requests a complete ad with a transformation and an ending.

plan.say: I’ll create a calm blue-and-white demo, animate the scattered tasks becoming an orderly day, and end with ClearDay’s name. The ad will be silent.

params.prompt_or_change: Minimal flat app-interface design in calm blue and white: a centered daily-planning demo screen with scattered, uneven task cards suggesting a messy to-do list; use checkbox icons and abstract blue lines instead of written words, ample white space, no device frame, no logos.

Keep the same minimal blue-and-white app interface, task-card appearance, and background; rearrange the scattered cards into a clean daily schedule with evenly spaced rows and a simple vertical timeline. Use icons and abstract lines only, no written words. Leave generous empty space at the bottom for the closing name.

steps.why: Create the organized destination while preserving the demo’s visual identity.

params.extra: First input is the start picture; second input is the end picture. Silent output; hold the organized layout for the final two seconds.
params.prompt_or_change: Minimal flat app demo animation: briefly hold the scattered task cards, then gently glide them into the orderly daily timeline of the end picture. Locked camera, smooth unhurried movement, calm blue-and-white palette, no added words or elements; finish with the organized screen held still.

steps.why: Animate the messy-to-organized transformation in one continuous clip.

params.extra: at: bottom; from: 6; to: 8; navy text on a white band; preserve silence
params.prompt_or_change: Show the exact closing name "ClearDay" centered at the bottom during the final two seconds.

steps.why: Guarantee a readable closing app name without asking the animation model to render text.
